fixes.backup: V6 archives preserve physical rows and exact links without changing app UUIDs; unique exports retain v5 behavior. Absent-version/v1–v5 duplicate archives upgrade in memory when saved references resolve uniquely. Omitted fields use existing legacy defaults; unknown actual measurements stay nil. Ambiguous/missing/conflicting parent links reject before mutation, with guidance; original bytes and v5 stream manifests remain unchanged.
fixes.cloud: Missing-record repair performs no app-directed record creation without an exact-set, one-use authorization. User reviews missing records and may schedule one restore for next launch; account/store/current payload are rechecked and a durable consumed receipt precedes any conditional creation. Newly missing IDs never join an approved set. Normal CloudKit synchronization remains enabled.
fixes.profile: Height/goal weight retain units in encrypted Keychain payload. Erased preferences restore from tags; legacy unknown units preserve raw values behind review, with no guessed measurement exposed. Locked/corrupt storage and failed writes preserve existing data.
adjacent_data_safety: Settings dedup requires matching content/actuals/provenance/physical parents; equal UUID alone is insufficient.
Migration handles independently moving main-app and shared app-group containers, including old journals and system path aliases.
Restore confirmation has an explicit Keep Records Local action.
